service.method: SELECT COUNT(SIAD.SMR_NUMBER) AS COUNT , UDGL.USE_NUMBER , SIAD.RE_FLAG , UDGL.SUBJECT FROM SUDGL UDGL JOIN SSIAD SIAD ON SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = UDGL.HOUSE_CODE AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = UDGL.COMPANY_CODE AND SIAD.REQ_SEAL_USE_TYPE = UDGL.USE_NUMBER WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SIAD.DEL_FLAG != 'Y' AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS = 'C' AND SIAD.CONFIRM_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SIAD.CONFIRM_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} GROUP BY UDGL.USE_NUMBER , SIAD.RE_FLAG , UDGL.SUBJECT

SELECT DEPT_NAME , RE_FLAG , USE_COUNT , RANKING FROM ( SELECT DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC AS DEPT_NAME , SIAD.RE_FLAG , COUNT(SIAD.SMR_NUMBER) AS USE_COUNT , DENSE_RANK () OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(SIAD.SMR_NUMBER) DESC) AS RANKING FROM SSIAD SIAD JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND SIAD.ADD_USER_DEPT = DEPT.DEPT WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND NVL(SIAD.DEL_FLAG, 'N') ='N' AND NVL(SIAD.RE_FLAG, 'E') ='E' AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS = 'C' AND SIAD.CONFIRM_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SIAD.CONFIRM_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} GROUP BY DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , SIAD.RE_FLAG ) WHERE RANKING <= 10

SELECT DEPT_NAME , RE_FLAG , USE_COUNT , RANKING FROM ( SELECT DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC AS DEPT_NAME , SIAD.RE_FLAG , COUNT(SIAD.SMR_NUMBER) AS USE_COUNT , DENSE_RANK () OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(SIAD.SMR_NUMBER) DESC) AS RANKING FROM SSIAD SIAD JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND SIAD.ADD_USER_DEPT = DEPT.DEPT WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND NVL(SIAD.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(SIAD.RE_FLAG, 'R') = 'R' AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS = 'C' AND SIAD.CONFIRM_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SIAD.CONFIRM_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} GROUP BY DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , SIAD.RE_FLAG ) WHERE RANKING <= 10

SELECT DEPT_NAME , USE_COUNT , RANKING , SIGN_STATUS FROM ( SELECT DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC AS DEPT_NAME , COUNT(SETL.SMR_NUMBER) AS USE_COUNT , DENSE_RANK () OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(SETL.SMR_NUMBER) DESC) AS RANKING , SETL.SIGN_STATUS FROM SSETL SETL JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON SETL.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND SETL.ADD_USER_DEPT = DEPT.DEPT WHERE SETL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SETL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND NVL(SETL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND SETL.SMR_STATUS = 'C' AND SETL.CONFIRM_DATE >= '20240530' AND SETL.CONFIRM_DATE <= '20240830' GROUP BY DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , SETL.SIGN_STATUS ORDER BY USE_COUNT DESC ) WHERE RANKING <= 10

SELECT SEAL.SUBJECT , SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER , COUNT(SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER) AS TOTAL_SMR_COUNT , SIAD.RE_FLAG FROM SSIAD SIAD INNER JOIN SSIPD_SEAL SPSEAL ON SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = SPSEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = SPSEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND SIAD.SMR_NUMBER = SPSEAL.SMR_NUMBER INNER JOIN SSEAL SEAL ON SPSEAL.HOUSE_CODE = SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND SPSEAL.COMPANY_CODE = SEAL.COMPANY_CODE AND SPSEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER = SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER WHERE SIAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SIAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SIAD.CONFIRM_DATE >= $S{F_CALENDAR_FROM} AND SIAD.CONFIRM_DATE <= $S{F_CALENDAR_TO} AND SIAD.DEL_FLAG != 'Y' AND SIAD.SMR_STATUS = 'C' GROUP BY SEAL.SUBJECT, SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER, SIAD.RE_FLAG
